title: Translates of a.e.-strongly measurable functions on balls
statement: Let n be a natural number, h : R^n -> R, r, s real numbers and z in R^n with r + |z| <= s. If h is a.e.-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to B_s := ball(0,s) in EuclideanSpace R (Fin n), then x |-> h(x - z) is a.e.-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to B_r := ball(0,r).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (r s : ℝ) (z : Rn n), r + ‖z‖ ≤ s → AEStronglyMeasurable h (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) s)) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => h (x - z)) (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) r))
